hypotheses.reasoning: At 13:32:33 notification-svc reloaded config revision 485, which changed TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to http://template-svc.internal:9090 (#1001). Renders succeeded right up to that reload (#1003, #1004 200 OK). From about 13:33:04 every notification-svc render to template-svc fails with connect ECONNREFUSED 10.2.165.226:9090 (#1034, #1087, #1173), meaning nothing is listening on that port. template-svc stays up, logging GC and render-OK lines through 13:43 with no errors, so the fault is the endpoint/port in the config, not a template-svc crash. notification-svc then returns 503s, so the gateway POST /v1/notify 503s (#1113, #1182, #1289, #1364) are downstream symptoms. The status-poller legacy-inventory timeouts are unrelated noise that predates the onset.

Connection refused could also mean template-svc is down. But template-svc kept logging GC and render-OK lines through 13:43, and the refusals began right after the config change at 13:32:33, so a crash is less likely than the wrong port.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll back notification-svc TEMPLATE_SVC_URL to the previous value (config revision 484), or correct the port to the one template-svc actually listens on, and verify with a test render. Review the config-service revision 485 change that set port 9090. Gateway success should recover once the URL is fixed.
